description: Build the vanilla HTML/JS single-page frontend that reads a runtime config.json, drives upload/list/status/delete against the FastAPI API, and plays HLS via hls.js with signed-cookie (prod) / signed-URL (local) handling. Independent of the API/worker implementations (contract-driven); must exist before FEAT-005 because AppStack's BucketDeployment points Source.asset at frontend/. Grounded in DESIGN.md sections: Overview (vanilla ES-module JS + hls.js), CloudFront + signed-cookie playback (same-origin, no withCredentials; re-call play-url on a segment 403), Local-dev approach (always fetch config.json; cp config.local.json config.json; playbackMode).
steps: Create frontend/index.html (no build step; loads app.js as a module and hls.js from a CDN) and frontend/styles.css. The app ALWAYS fetches config.json at startup for { apiBaseUrl, region, playbackMode } -- never branch on hostname.

Create frontend/app.js (ES module): upload form -> POST {apiBaseUrl}/videos (multipart); gallery that polls GET {apiBaseUrl}/videos and renders status badges including Failed; a delete action -> DELETE {apiBaseUrl}/videos/{video_id}; a play action that calls GET {apiBaseUrl}/videos/{video_id}/play-url and hands the returned playlist URL to the player.

Create frontend/player.js: initialize hls.js on the returned playlist URL. In production playback is same-origin under the one CloudFront domain so cookies attach automatically (NO withCredentials/xhrSetup). On a segment 403, re-call play-url to refresh the cookies/URL and resume. Handle the local signed-URL (rewritten playlist) mode identically from the player's perspective (it just loads the URL the API returned).

Create the checked-in frontend/config.local.json with { "apiBaseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8000", "playbackMode": "signed-url", "region": "us-east-1" }. Ensure frontend/config.json is gitignored (via iac/.gitignore or a frontend/.gitignore) -- in AWS it is produced by BucketDeployment (FEAT-005) with apiBaseUrl "/api" and playbackMode "cookie"; locally the developer runs `cp frontend/config.local.json frontend/config.json`.
acceptance_criteria: node --check on app.js and player.js reports no syntax errors.

After `cp frontend/config.local.json frontend/config.json` and serving on 127.0.0.1:5500, the page loads, fetches config.json, and renders the upload form + (empty) gallery without console errors (recorded in findings).
config.json is gitignored and config.local.json is committed with the local values.
verification: cd projects/video-streaming-app/frontend && node --check app.js && node --check player.js
cp config.local.json config.json && python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 5500 (background) then curl -f http://127.0.0.1:5500/ and curl -f http://127.0.0.1:5500/config.json, stop it
git check-ignore frontend/config.json confirms it is ignored
findings:
Implemented frontend/ (index.html, styles.css, app.js, player.js, config.local.json, .gitignore). All verification passed on Node v22.23.2: `node --check app.js` + `node --check player.js` OK (Node 22 auto-detects ESM syntax in .js, so no package.json type:module needed); `python3 -m http.server --bind 127.0.0.1 5500` serves / (200, index.html), /config.json (200, local values), /app.js (200); `git check-ignore frontend/config.json` -> config.json (ignored). No console errors expected at load: app.js init() fetches config.json then calls GET {apiBaseUrl}/videos; against a running local API the gallery renders empty, standalone it logs a fetch error to console only (not a syntax/load error).

ASSET PATH for FEAT-005: AppStack BucketDeployment must point Source at projects/video-streaming-app/frontend/ (the directory holding index.html/app.js/player.js/styles.css). It must EXCLUDE config.local.json and write config.json itself via s3deploy.Source.json_data("config.json", {"apiBaseUrl": "/api", "playbackMode": "cookie", "region": "us-east-1"}). config.json is gitignored (frontend/.gitignore) so it is NEVER in the asset source tree; BucketDeployment supplies it.

API CONTRACT consumed (matches api/main.py as built): POST {base}/videos multipart fields `file` + `title` -> {video_id,status:'Queued'}; GET {base}/videos -> {videos:[{video_id,status,title,original_filename,created_at,gsi_pk}]}; GET {base}/videos/{id} -> item; GET {base}/videos/{id}/play-url -> {play_url, mode} (mode 'cookie'|'signed-url'), 409 with detail.status when not Ready; DELETE {base}/videos/{id} -> {deleted}. Statuses rendered as badges: Queued/Processing/Ready/Failed (Play button enabled only when status==="Ready").

PLAYER behavior: player.js uses global `Hls` from CDN (hls.js@1.5.17 via jsdelivr in index.html), NO withCredentials/xhrSetup (prod media is same-origin under CloudFront so signed cookies attach automatically; local signed-url mode just loads the rewritten-playlist URL the API returns). On any hls error whose data.response.code===403 it calls onRefresh() (re-GET play-url) and reloads the source; Safari native-HLS fallback included. Both prod (cookie) and local (signed-url) modes are handled identically from the player's view — playbackMode in config.json is informational; the player keys off the URL the API returns, not the mode string.

AWS-doc confirmation for the VPC-origin SG (FEAT-005 MED_vpc_origin_sg) is NOT covered by this feature — still OWED by FEAT-005.

minor: config.json was created during verification via `cp config.local.json config.json` and removed afterward; it is gitignored and not committed.
